meaning.th: ทุกครั้งที่ ~

meaning.vi: được quyết định là ~, thành ra ~
meaning.en: it is decided / it turns out that ~
meaning.th: ได้รับกำหนดให้ ~

quiz.ja: 人魚姫は、人間の足のために何をわたしましたか。

explain.vi: Nàng trao giọng hát tuyệt đẹp cho mụ phù thủy.
explain.en: She gave her beautiful voice to the witch.
explain.zh-Hans: 她把美妙的声音给了巫婆。
explain.tl: Ibinigay niya ang magandang tinig sa bruha.
explain.pt: Ela deu sua linda voz à bruxa.
explain.my: လှပတဲ့ အသံကို စုန်းမကို ပေးခဲ့တယ်။
explain.th: นางมอบเสียงอันไพเราะให้แม่มด

quiz.ja: 王子は人魚姫を、どのように思っていましたか。

explain.vi: Chàng thương nàng như thương một cô em gái.
explain.en: He cared for her like a little sister.
explain.zh-Hans: 他像对妹妹一样疼爱她。
explain.tl: Inalagaan niya siya gaya ng kapatid.
explain.pt: Ele a via como uma irmãzinha.
explain.my: ညီမလို ချစ်ခင်တယ်။
explain.th: เขาเอ็นดูนางเหมือนน้องสาว

quiz.ja: 姉たちは、何と交換してナイフをもらいましたか。

explain.vi: Các chị đổi mái tóc dài lấy con dao.
explain.en: The sisters traded their long hair for the knife.
explain.zh-Hans: 姐姐们用长发换来了刀。
explain.ne: दिदीहरूले लामो कपाल दिएर चक्कु पाए।
explain.id: Mereka menukar rambut panjang dengan pisau.
explain.pt: Trocaram os cabelos longos pela faca.
explain.my: ဆံပင်ရှည်နဲ့ လဲပြီး ဓား ရခဲ့တယ်။
explain.th: พี่ ๆ แลกผมยาวกับมีด

quiz.ja: 最後に、人魚姫は何になりましたか。

explain.vi: Nàng không thành bọt biển mãi mãi mà trở thành con gái của không trung.
explain.en: Instead of vanishing as foam, she became a daughter of the air.
explain.zh-Hans: 她没有就此消失，而是成了空气的女儿。
explain.ko: 거품으로 사라지지 않고 하늘의 딸이 되었다.
explain.pt: Ela virou uma filha do ar.
explain.my: ကောင်းကင်ရဲ့ သမီး ဖြစ်သွားတယ်။
explain.th: นางกลายเป็นธิดาแห่งอากาศ
